text.tspan: Only anchor and valence share a profile

​Pearson r between each pair's effect vectors. Recursive self-improvement and positive views on humans move under every condition, so they inflate every correlation: drop them and phenomenality-continuity​
​falls from 0.94 to 0.19, while anchor-valence holds at 0.96.​
